title: 2x Plug Plants Broad Bean Bison Early High Yield Light Green Beans
description:
Broad Bean ‘Bison’ is an early, vigorous variety producing premium quality seeds. Plants grow to around 90cm tall and crop 70–75 days from sowing.



Pods: large, 14–17cm long



Each pod contains 2–5 thick, well-formed seeds



Seeds are light green, regular in shape, and excellent in flavour



Suitable for eating fresh after harvest, or for freezing, preserving, and pickling
